channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Quando a investigação se aproxima do poder
item.description: The Lula government's decision to recall Federal Police deputies assigned to other bodies, including judges' offices, coincides with the advancement of the Master Case investigations, which now implicate both opposition figures and government officials. While the move raises concerns of political interference, the text emphasizes that the true test of institutional autonomy occurs when oversight bodies investigate government allies—not just opponents. Such institutions are vital for reducing information asymmetry between rulers and voters, even when their actions impose political costs on incumbents.

item.title: Bolsonaro presta depoimento no DF em semana em que vence prisão domiciliar
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro faces a critical decision regarding the maintenance or revocation of his house arrest, whose 90-day period ends on March 25. The measure was granted by STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes on March 24, 2024, for his recovery after hospitalization. This week will be decisive for his legal status.

item.title: Paulo Serra desiste de candidatura ao governo de SP e anuncia pré-candidatura a deputado federal
item.description: Former Santo André mayor Paulo Serra (PSDB) abandoned his bid for São Paulo governor in 2026 and announced a pre-candidacy for federal deputy, stating he wishes to contribute more effectively to the state and country. His decision follows Solidariedade and PRD endorsing Tarcísio de Freitas’ re-election, making his gubernatorial run unviable. Serra now aims to build a party alliance to support his federal campaign, emphasizing fiscal responsibility and administrative efficiency.

item.title: Congresso aprova educação política como disciplina obrigatória
item.description: On June 17, 2026, the Brazilian Federal Senate approved PL 4.088/2023, making 'political education and citizenship rights' a mandatory subject in basic education by amending Article 26 of the LDB. The bill, originally proposed by Deputy Renata Hellmeister (Podemos-SP), does not specify the grade level or teacher qualifications and received only one opposing vote, from Senator Hamilton Mourão (Republicanos-RS). It now awaits presidential sanction by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).

item.title: Depois de Kataguiri, Paulo Serra (PSDB) também desiste de concorrer ao governo de São Paulo
item.description: Former mayor of Santo André, Paulo Serra (PSDB), withdrew from the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race and will run for federal deputy, following Kim Kataguiri’s (Missão) decision to abandon his pré-candidacy for the Palácio dos Bandeirantes. With Serra and Kataguiri stepping down, the contest for governor now centers on incumbent Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), who leads polls with 45.6% voter intent, and former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT), at 34.1%. The poll margin of error is 2.5 percentage points.

item.title: 'Esperança vai vencer o medo': como surgiu slogan de Lula que Flávio copiou
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro repeated the slogan 'Hope will overcome fear', originally used by Lula in his 2002 presidential campaign. The phrase emerged after a reading of a poem by Pernambucan sociologist Gilberto Freyre at an event in Rio de Janeiro, which inspired the PT's narrative of hope against fear. Flávio's use of the slogan was noted as a direct copy of Lula's communication strategy.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia completa 20 anos como ministra do STF
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia completed 20 years of service at the STF on Sunday (June 21, 2026), being the first and only woman currently on the Court and responsible for drafting its ethics code. Appointed by Lula in 2006, she has previously presided over the STF, CNJ, and TSE twice, and acted as interim President of the Republic on four occasions. Commemorations include the publication of a book compiling her key votes and special content on TV Justiça, Rádio Justiça, and the STF’s digital platforms.

item.title: Após Kim, tucano também desiste de disputa ao governo de SP e Tarcísio e Haddad duelam para herdar votos
item.description: São Paulo tucans Paulo Serra (former mayor of Santo André) and Kim Kataguiri have withdrawn from the 2026 gubernatorial race, opting to run for federal deputy instead. Their exit reduces electoral fragmentation, leaving Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) as the main contenders, with polls showing Tarcísio leading at 38% versus Haddad’s 26%. Neither tucano has yet endorsed another candidate.

item.title: A Copa 2026 e a política das emoções
item.description: Brazil's performance in the 2026 World Cup may influence voter behavior, as citizens often assign responsibility for uncontrollable events to governments. This undermines democratic rationality, since voting may reflect luck rather than governance quality. While autocrats exploit such events to boost popularity, their rule relies on force and repression, not electoral legitimacy.

item.title: Nunes aumenta participação em pré-campanhas de Flávio e Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) collaborated on three policy areas of presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) government plan: transportation, food security, and public safety. This alignment suggests strategic cooperation between the MDB and Bolsonaro’s faction on urban governance and public policy. The article was published on June 21, 2026, at 14:29.

item.title: Defesa é vital em audiência sobre tarifas dos EUA, diz economista
item.description: Economist Gustavo Sampaio, a professor at FGV, is the only Brazilian registered for the USTR public hearing on potential 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, set for July 6 in Washington. He notes the Brazilian government has not confirmed attendance and expresses distrust in the process, but stresses the importance of participating to avoid a default judgment. Sampaio also submitted documents to defend Pix as state infrastructure, arguing the proposed tariffs are 'analog solutions to digital problems'.

item.title: Paulo Serra desiste de concorrer ao governo de SP e ajuda Tarcísio
item.description: Former Santo André mayor Paulo Serra (PSDB) abandoned his gubernatorial pre-candidacy in São Paulo and announced he will run for federal deputy in 2026. His decision follows Kataguiri's withdrawal, consolidating right-wing support behind Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), who leads polls with 45.6% voter intention. Both Serra (4.6%) and Kataguiri (3%) trailed Tarcísio and Haddad (PT) in recent surveys.

item.title: Zelenskiy aceita oferta de Lula para mediar paz na Ucrânia
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy accepted Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s proposal to mediate a peace agreement in the war with Russia, as confirmed by a Ukrainian presidential aide following their meeting at the G7 summit in France. Lula advocates for the involvement of the five permanent members of the UN Security Council (U.S., France, U.K., Russia, and China), emphasizing their veto power to decide on war or peace. Negotiations are progressing with a commitment to achieve concrete results based on proposed ideas, without additional conditions from Ukraine, aiming for a ceasefire to enable peace talks.

item.title: Dois ex-jogadores da Seleção Brasileira devem disputar vaga na Câmara em 2026
item.description: Two former Brazil national team players, Edmundo and Luís Fabiano, have confirmed their pre-candidacies for the Chamber of Deputies in the 2026 elections. Edmundo, nicknamed 'Animal', joined the PSDB in Rio de Janeiro and pledged to defend Vasco da Gama if elected. Luís Fabiano, known as 'Fabuloso', affiliated with the MDB in São Paulo with support from Mayor Ricardo Nunes and aims to focus his mandate on promoting sports and digital inclusion.

item.title: Fama mundial na Copa expõe distância entre Vozinha e outros goleiros
item.description: Cabo Verdean goalkeeper Vozinha gained global fame after holding Spain to a goalless draw in the 2026 World Cup, earning man-of-the-match honors and surging from 50,000 to over 13 million Instagram followers in days. Despite his newfound stardom, his monthly salary of €8,400 at GD Chaves is nearly 100 times lower than Brazil’s Alisson Becker, who earns €9.3 million annually at Liverpool. His market value of €50,000 also pales in comparison to Alisson’s €15 million valuation.

item.title: A próxima pesquisa intenção de voto para presidente
item.description: The PoderData poll to be released on Friday, June 26, will be based on 2,400 phone interviews with a two-point margin of error. President Lula (PT) leads the first round with 40%, followed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 35%, while no other pre-candidate exceeds 4%. In a hypothetical runoff, Lula leads with 46% against Bolsonaro’s 42%, within the margin of error.

item.title: Área técnica do TCU cobra explicação da Caixa sobre licitação de publicidade de R$ 760 milhões
item.description: The technical area of the TCU requested explanations from Caixa regarding possible irregularities in a R$ 760 million annual advertising procurement, citing lack of objective criteria, improper use of 'best technique' over 'technique and price', and absence of public session recording. The case was filed by Cálix Propaganda, linked to publicist Marcello Lopes, former marketer for Flávio Bolsonaro. Caixa states its tenders comply with legislation and will provide clarifications to the court.

item.title: Zema reafirma críticas a Flávio Bolsonaro por relação com Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema, the pré-candidate for president from the Novo party, reiterated his criticism of the closeness between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and banker Daniel Vorcaro, who is detained on allegations of leading a billion-dollar financial fraud scheme. In an interview on the podcast Cortadas do Firmino, Zema emphasized concerns about ethics and integrity in politics.

item.title: Por que eleitores de Roraima votam para governador neste domingo
item.description: Roraima voters go to the polls this Sunday in a supplementary election for governor and vice-governor after the TSE annulled Edilson Damião’s mandate due to political and economic abuse of power. Three tickets are competing: Arthur Henrique and Subtenente Velton (PL), whose candidacy is sub judice; Nelita Frank and Barto Macuxi (PT/PSOL); and Soldado Sampaio and Tayla Peres (Republicanos), with the current interim governor on the ticket. Voting is mandatory, and the winner will serve until January 2027, when the October-elected governor will take office.

item.title: Roraima elege neste domingo governador para mandato tampão até 2027
item.description: Roraima holds a supplementary gubernatorial election for a temporary term until 2027, following the removal of former governor Edilson Damião for political and economic abuse in 2022. Candidates include Arthur Henrique (PL), backed by the ousted governor and currently running 'sub judice' due to an STF challenge; Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos), the interim governor; and Nelita Frank (PT), from the opposition. Voting takes place this Sunday (21) from 8 AM to 5 PM across 350 polling stations, with 384,000 eligible voters.

item.title: Eleição para mandato tampão em Roraima acontece neste domingo
item.description: Roraima holds a supplementary election this Sunday to choose a governor for a temporary term until 2027, following the removal of former governor Edilson Damao for abuse of power. Three candidates are running: Arthur Henrique (PL), Soldado Sampaio (Republicanos), and Nelita Frank (PT), with Henrique facing potential disqualification due to a STF ruling on candidacy eligibility.

item.title: Neymar provoca nova briga entre direita e esquerda
item.description: President Lula's comment calling Neymar the 'first world home office call-up' sparked backlash from right-wing politicians like Flávio Bolsonaro and Nikolas Ferreira, who defended the player and criticized the president. The controversy unfolded amid Brazil's preparations for the 2026 World Cup, with Neymar pursuing a historic sixth title and becoming a political symbol in the clash between bolsonarismo and lulismo. Despite Neymar's indirect response, the focus remained on the political instrumentalization of his image.

item.title: Joaquim Barbosa é desqualificado e pedirei revisão criminal, diz Delúbio
item.description: Delúbio Soares, former PT treasurer and federal deputy candidate for Goiás in 2026, claims innocence and plans to seek criminal revision of his Mensalão and Lava Jato convictions. He harshly criticizes former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa, the rapporteur in the Mensalão case, calling him 'unqualified' and saying he would not invite him to dinner. Delúbio also mocks the possibility of Barbosa running for president in 2026 under the Christian Democracy party, stating that neither he nor voters see it as viable.

item.title: TSE manda excluir publicação de Sóstenes Cavalcante com acusação sem prova ao PT
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of a social media post by federal deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante that linked the Workers' Party (PT) to criminal organizations without evidence, stating it exceeded the bounds of legitimate political criticism. The ruling mandates deletion within 24 hours, imposes daily fines for non-compliance, and bans reposting equivalent content.

item.title: Por que Flávio Bolsonaro se complicou mais que Wagner?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faced greater complications than Jaques Wagner because, while Wagner’s involvement is seen as an individual responsibility harming the government’s image, Flávio’s case directly undermines his presidential ambitions as a pre-candidate. Ricardo Noblat argues that Flávio’s situation carries institutional and personal gravity, tied to his national power project, unlike Wagner’s case, which does not implicate President Lula. This has isolated Flávio on the right, according to the Datafolha poll cited in the program.

item.title: O petit comitê montado por ex-diretor do BC para ouvir Zema
item.description: Former Central Bank monetary policy director Luiz Fernando Figueiredo hosted a dinner at his São Paulo home for 45 guests to hear Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate. Figueiredo praised Zema for his experience, entrepreneurial spirit, ethics, and concern for Brazil, while his wife Andrea said attendees left feeling hopeful. Figueiredo, now a philanthropist and partner at Jubarte Capital, leads the Instituto Fefig, which focuses on child literacy in public schools across 80 municipalities.

item.title: Governo Lula deixa fora do limite de gasto 94% do pacote de bondades
item.description: The Lula government allocated R$187.2 billion in direct benefits to voters in 2024, of which R$176.7 billion (94%) fell outside the spending limit of the fiscal framework, and R$118.7 billion (63%) even escaped the primary surplus target. Economist Marcos Mendes warns this volume of exceptions undermines the fiscal rule, leading to chronically high deficits. Mechanisms include state bank loans, use of idle funds, tax cuts, and extraordinary credits—all increasing public debt.

item.title: Kataguiri diz que será ministro em eventual governo de Renan Santos
item.description: Federal deputy Kim Kataguiri (Mission-SP) announced he is withdrawing from the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial race and will seek re-election to the Chamber of Deputies. He stated that if pre-candidate Renan Santos wins the presidency, he will assume a future 'Ministry of State Reform' in Santos’ government. The statement was made on Saturday, the 20th, and reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: O que dizem as pesquisas da semana sobre a disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Three polls released this week (Nexus/BTG, CNT/MDA, and Datafolha) show Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro in a hypothetical second-round scenario for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, with leads ranging from 5 to 12.5 percentage points. Margins of error range from 2 to 2.2 points, and blank/null votes and undecided voters remain notable, especially in the CNT/MDA survey. Lula maintains consistent support across institutes, while Flávio Bolsonaro's support fluctuates between 36.8% and 43%.

item.title: Número de candidatas a deputada sobe, mas número de eleitas segue baixo
item.description: The number of female candidates for federal deputy grew nearly tenfold from 1998 to 2022, but the number of elected women increased by only 210%, revealing a gap between candidacy and actual representation. In 2022, women held 17.5% of seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 17.8% in state assemblies — historical highs, yet still below gender parity and the 30% minimum for candidacies. Researchers attribute this to unequal campaign funding, systematic exclusion from party decision-making, and the use of 'dummy' female candidacies to meet legal quotas without ensuring real competitiveness.

item.title: A variação na popularidade de Lula desde o início do ano, segundo o Datafolha
item.description: President Lula's government approval remains stable, with 32% rating it as good or excellent, 38% as bad or terrible, and 29% as regular, according to a June 2026 Datafolha poll. Approval has fluctuated narrowly between 29% and 32% since December 2025, while disapproval ranged from 37% to 40%. The survey interviewed 2,004 people from June 17–19, with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Zema cita Taylor Swift em vídeo que ironiza Lula e Jaques Wagner
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential pre-candidate and former governor of Minas Gerais, released a video in his 'Os Intocáveis' series that satirizes Lula and Senator Jaques Wagner using AI, incorporating references to Taylor Swift. The video was posted on Instagram and forms part of a political communication strategy targeting young, digitally engaged voters.

item.title: Alvo de fogo amigo, coordenador da campanha de Flávio foi escolhido por seu pai
item.description: Rogério Marinho, general coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign for the 2026 elections, has come under fire from allies for being overly centralized and lacking inclusiveness in his role, facing 'friendly fire'. Despite the criticism, there is no expectation he will be removed, as even dissatisfied allies do not believe he will be replaced.

item.title: Submerso após operação da PF, Ciro Nogueira segue ativo no Piauí
item.description: Ciro Nogueira has maintained a low national profile following a PF operation last month but remains active in Piauí, where he is seeking re-election in October. While he has adopted a stance of neutrality in the presidential race — interpreted as a political position given expectations that he would support Flávio Bolsonaro as a Centrão leader — his approach reflects strategic caution. The text also notes parallel events, including Jaques Wagner’s move to a luxury apartment in Bahia and a video of Ciro relaxing in Ibiza.

item.title: FHC, 95 anos: jovens do PT e do PL analisam prós e contras do tucano
item.description: Young leaders from the PT and PL assess Fernando Henrique Cardoso's legacy, praising the Real Plan for stabilizing the economy but criticizing liberal reforms and privatizations for perpetuating inequality and creating what petista governments call a 'cursed legacy'. The PSDB, once dominant, has declined electorally, while the PL and PT have risen as the main political forces, with Flavio Bolsonaro and Lula leading polls for the 2026 presidency.

item.title: O receio de aliados de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre estreia de 'Dark Horse' antes das eleições
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro are advising him to conduct a qualitative study to determine whether the film 'Dark Horse', a controversial biopic financed by Daniel Vorcaro about his father Jair Bolsonaro, should be released in Brazil before or after the 2026 elections. The concern is that an early release could negatively impact the electoral campaign due to the film’s polarizing nature. Full access to the article requires a subscription.

item.title: Uma segunda reunião entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a second in-person meeting with banker Daniel Vorcaro in São Paulo, in addition to the acknowledged meeting by Zero Um in late November 2025. The discussions centered on securing R$134 million in financing for the film 'Dark horse', aiming to finalize negotiations. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Como Eduardo montou nos EUA rede de contatos que o levaram a Donald Trump e à condenação no STF
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro built a U.S. network during a November–December 2018 trip organized by Márcio Coimbra, which included a dinner with Steve Bannon, where he was named representative of The Movement in Brazil. These connections facilitated his access to the Trump administration and his advocacy for sanctions against Brazilian authorities, including STF ministers. This activity led to his 2025 conviction by Brazil’s Supreme Court for obstructing justice, after attempting to interfere in the trial of his father, Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: PT ‘esconde’ pautas de comportamento para atrair evangélicos
item.description: The PT is avoiding discussions on social issues like abortion and same-sex marriage to attract evangelical voters, who reject Lula in 60% according to a recent Genial/Quaest poll. National coordinator of the party's inter-religious sector, Gutierres Barbosa, says the strategy is to engage with kindness and avoid hate speech, aiming to reach former Bolsonaro supporters and moderate religious leaders. The party is also promoting a narrative of Lula as more patriotic than the Bolsonaro family, especially after international actions attributed to them.

item.title: Congelamento no Orçamento das agências reguladoras cresce 745% em 2026
item.description: In 2026, the Lula government froze R$382 million in the budget of regulatory agencies, a figure 745% higher than the total for 2025 (R$42.2 million). The increase stems solely from expense blocks, as no contingency measures were applied this year. The Senate approved a bill banning the contingency of funds for regulatory agencies, placing their activities as exceptions to the Fiscal Responsibility Law.

item.title: O fator Master nesta eleição
item.description: The Banco Master has become a relevant factor in the 2026 election, revealing the depth of the crisis involving banker Daniel Vorcaro, who sought to exploit political influence to access public funds under the false claim of private money. Senate government leader Jaques Wagner must defend himself with solid arguments, while far-right pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro cannot evade responsibility for the weak claim that the involvement was with private funds. The article stresses that it was never private money, but a scheme involving public resources and improper pressure on authorities.

item.title: E La Nave va
item.description: The DataFolha poll suggests that neither Lula has reached his electoral ceiling nor Flávio Bolsonaro maintained his floor, with a possibility of a first-round win or a technical tie in the runoff. Other candidates, especially on the right, lack momentum to gain traction in the next two months. The election appears to be shaping up as a contest between the most rejected candidates, many implicated in corruption scandals.

item.title: A dez dias do fim do prazo, governo ainda não pagou 10% do valor mínimo de emendas previstas para o 1º semestre
item.description: With ten days left until the LDO deadline, the government has not paid 10% of the minimum individual and bench amendments for the first semester, leaving R$1.6 billion in PIX amendments unpaid. As of June 18, R$15.8 billion of the R$17.3 billion allocated had been disbursed, including R$2.8 billion in PIX amendments (63% of the required amount). Experts warn the delay creates electoral imbalance in 2026, advantaging deputies with greater access to funds and entrenching a privileged 'caste' in Congress.

item.title: Novo Datafolha faz Lula manter vantagem no Rali, agregador de pesquisas do GLOBO; veja números
item.description: The latest Datafolha poll released on Saturday shows Lula maintaining his lead over Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round, with 45.9% versus 41.6%, according to the Rali aggregator by GLOBO and Instituto Locomotiva. In the first round, Lula stands at 39.8% and Flávio at 30.9%, with other candidates collectively reaching 17%. The scenario has stabilized after an earlier rise tied to revelations about Flávio Bolsonaro’s conversations with Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Do sertanejo à MPB, Lula e Flávio buscam artistas para ampliar alcance de campanhas
item.description: Lula seeks support from MPB and left-leaning artists, with Janja acting as a cultural intermediary to broaden campaign reach. Flávio Bolsonaro, meanwhile, is targeting the sertanejo music scene to connect with rural and agribusiness voters through artists like Gusttavo Lima and strategic events. Both campaigns are leveraging cultural figures to reduce resistance and expand electoral reach, particularly among audiences not traditionally engaged with politics.

item.title: Tarcísio adapta caravanas para facilitar contato com prefeitos
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas has adjusted the format of his statewide caravans in São Paulo to host lunches and dinners with mayors and legislators, aiming to increase proximity after complaints about limited access. Led by Government Secretary Roberto Carneiro, the shift replaced formal podium-style meetings with informal gatherings in cities such as Santos, Campinas, and Ribeirão Preto, some lasting into the early morning. The move seeks to strengthen ties with local leaders ahead of the 2026 election, countering PT claims of neglect by highlighting infrastructure projects like the northern Rodoanel and highway upgrades.

item.title: Quase três anos depois, Neymar se aproxima de retorno à seleção e coloca à prova minutos jogados pelo Santos
item.description: Neymar is nearing a return to the Brazil national team after nearly three years sidelined due to injury, having recovered from a left knee ligament and meniscus tear suffered in October 2023. He has been regaining match fitness with Santos in 2026, averaging 84.3 minutes per game across 15 appearances, and may feature against Scotland in the World Cup on Wednesday, pending his physical progress in training.

item.title: Lula atropelou Tabata e suas colegas
item.description: Lula was accused of running over Tabata Amaral and her female colleagues in a context of digital misogyny, where women face threats, persecution, sexual exposure, and silencing. The article emphasizes that such violence scales rapidly online, requiring a well-designed public response. The content is subscriber-only and calls for registration.

item.title: Trump banca o chefão no G7 e troca chumbo com Lula, que pode ficar mais isolado na América do Sul
item.description: Donald Trump arrived late to the G7 meeting and, upon entering, theatrically declared himself 'the boss', drawing attention. The incident occurred amid diplomatic tensions, with Lula potentially becoming more isolated in South America. The article is subscriber-only and highlights Trump's dominant behavior on the international stage.

item.title: Copa do Mundo: 9º dia tem Alemanha classificada e goleada da Holanda
item.description: The 9th day of the 2026 FIFA World Cup saw Germany advance to the knockout stage for the first time in 12 years, with Manuel Neuer becoming the all-time appearance leader for goalkeepers (21 matches). The Netherlands crushed Sweden 5-1, extending their World Cup winning streak to a record 14 consecutive victories. Paraguay defeated Turkey 1-0 with the fastest goal in tournament history, while Miguel Almirón became the first player sent off under the 'Vini Jr. protocol'.
